intro: Make an impression with the Onyx table, featuring a marble-look UV-coated top and solid wood legs. Designed for strength and style, it’s the perfect anchor for conversations and celebrations​.

features.title: MDF top with marble-look finish
features.text: The MDF tabletop’s marble-look finish adds a touch of elegance that makes every meal feel special.

features.title: UV coating for protection
features.text: We built this to last through daily use. A UV coating protects against scratches, stains, and wear—keeping your table looking new longer.

features.title: Solid wood legs for strength
features.text: Enjoy everyday durability—the solid rubberwood base offers strength that holds up through countless meals and memories.

features.title: Elegant cappuccino wood finish
features.text: Warm up your space—the cappuccino-coloured wood finish adds sophistication and an inviting atmosphere.

features.title: Perfect size for six
features.text: Comfortably seats six, making it perfect for casual family meals or celebratory gatherings.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
